import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Rectangle
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 9, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" ochre = "#D4A72C" ink = "#263238" muted = "#657786" light = "#D8E0E3"
x = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4]) if x.size != 4: raise ValueError("This recursion diagram requires the supplied four-point input.") e = np.fft.fft(x[::2]) o = np.fft.fft(x[1::2]) expected = np.array([10, -2 + 2j, -2, -2 - 2j]) if not np.allclose(np.fft.fft(x), expected): raise ValueError("The supplied input and FFT output are inconsistent.")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 4), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 960) ax.set_ylim(0, 400) ax.axis("off")
def text(x, y, s, size=9, color=ink, weight="normal", ha="left", va="center", **kwargs): return ax.text( x, y, s, fontsize=size, color=color, weight=weight, ha=ha, va=va, **kwargs )
def arrow(start, end, color=muted, lw=1.15, style="-|>", alpha=1): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle=style, mutation_scale=8, linewidth=lw, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, alpha=alpha, zorder=1 ) ax.add_patch(patch) return patch
text(26, 374, "Recursive FFT in Rust", size=16, weight="bold") text(933, 374, "fft(&[1, 2, 3, 4]) · N = 4", size=10, ha="right", color=muted)
text(26, 338, "1 Split by index parity", size=10.5, weight="bold") text(245, 309, "x = [1, 2, 3, 4]", size=11, ha="center", weight="bold")
arrow((210, 297), (135, 281), blue) arrow((280, 297), (355, 281), teal)
text(130, 269, "even = [x[0], x[2]]", color=blue, ha="center") text(130, 251, "= [1, 3]", size=10, color=blue, ha="center", weight="bold") text(355, 269, "odd = [x[1], x[3]]", color=teal, ha="center") text(355, 251, "= [2, 4]", size=10, color=teal, ha="center", weight="bold")
text(26, 223, "2 Recursive 2-point FFT calls", size=10.5, weight="bold", bbox=dict(facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", pad=2)) text(465, 223, "N = 1: return input", size=8, color=muted, ha="right")
for center, color in [(130, blue), (355, teal)]: arrow((center - 15, 241), (center - 44, 196), color, alpha=0.65) arrow((center + 15, 241), (center + 44, 196), color, alpha=0.65)
for xpos, val, color in [ (86, 1, blue), (174, 3, blue), (311, 2, teal), (399, 4, teal) ]: text(xpos, 185, f"[{val}]", size=10, ha="center", color=color, bbox=dict(facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", pad=2))
for center, color in [(130, blue), (355, teal)]: arrow((center - 40, 174), (center - 10, 160), color, alpha=0.65) arrow((center + 40, 174), (center + 10, 160), color, alpha=0.65)
text(130, 154, "e = fft(&[1, 3])", color=blue, ha="center", weight="bold") text(355, 154, "o = fft(&[2, 4])", color=teal, ha="center", weight="bold") text(130, 136, "k = 0, w = 1", size=8.5, color=muted, ha="center") text(355, 136, "k = 0, w = 1", size=8.5, color=muted, ha="center") text(130, 117, "e[0] = 1 + 3 = 4", ha="center") text(130, 100, "e[1] = 1 − 3 = −2", ha="center") text(355, 117, "o[0] = 2 + 4 = 6", ha="center") text(355, 100, "o[1] = 2 − 4 = −2", ha="center") text(130, 78, "e = [4, −2]", color=blue, size=10, ha="center", weight="bold") text(355, 78, "o = [6, −2]", color=teal, size=10, ha="center", weight="bold")
text(511, 338, "3 Butterfly loop", size=10.5, weight="bold") text(933, 338, "k = 0..2 (0, 1)", size=9, color=muted, ha="right") text(511, 316, "out[k] = e[k] + p; out[k + 2] = e[k] − p", size=8.8, color=muted)
def butterfly(y, k, even_value, product, upper, lower): x_start, x_end = 606, 704 upper_y, lower_y = y, y - 31 text(597, upper_y, f"e[{k}] = {even_value}", size=8.5, ha="right", color=blue) text(597, lower_y, f"p = {product}", size=8.5, ha="right", color=ink) arrow((x_start, upper_y), (x_end, upper_y), muted, lw=1.05) arrow((x_start, lower_y), (x_end, lower_y), muted, lw=1.05) arrow((x_start, upper_y), (x_end, lower_y), muted, lw=1.05, alpha=0.65) arrow((x_start, lower_y), (x_end, upper_y), muted, lw=1.05, alpha=0.65) text(714, upper_y, "+", size=10, ha="center", weight="bold") text(714, lower_y, "−", size=10, ha="center", weight="bold") text(731, upper_y, upper, size=8.8) text(731, lower_y, lower, size=8.8)
text(511, 286, "k = 0 θ = 0, w = 1", size=9.5, weight="bold") text(511, 265, "p = 1 × 6 = 6", size=9.5, bbox=dict(facecolor="#F8F0D9", edgecolor="none", pad=3)) butterfly(241, 0, "4", "6", "out[0] = 4 + 6 = 10", "out[2] = 4 − 6 = −2")
text(511, 181, "k = 1 θ = −π/2, w = −i", size=9.5, weight="bold") text(511, 160, "p = (−i) × (−2) = 2i", size=9.5, bbox=dict(facecolor="#F8F0D9", edgecolor="none", pad=3)) butterfly(136, 1, "−2", "2i", "out[1] = −2 + 2i", "out[3] = −2 − 2i")
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((26, 15), 907, 42, facecolor="#F0F5F6", edgecolor="none")) text(44, 36, "Final output", size=10, weight="bold") text(480, 36, "[10, −2 + 2i, −2, −2 − 2i]", size=12, ha="center", weight="bold") text(916, 36, "Forward FFT", size=8.5, ha="right", color=muted)
